あらすじ

It’s July, and the rainy season has ended.

My name is Kurosaki Ichita, and I’m a second-year student at a nearby school.

Just the other day, my childhood friend Yuna confessed her feelings to me and we’ve started going out, but I’m a little stuck.

The reason is that I’ve had a crush on someone for a while now…

  • 英語名: Chichi Miko!! Plus 1 Sobo to Musume no Sakunyuu Harem

あらすじ

More than ten years have passed since then…

My name is Matsushita Ukyou. I’m currently assisting at the Chichiizumi Shrine. My grandmother Touka, the head priestess, is still the Breast Priestess of Chichiizumi Shrine, of course.

Touka and I were united in the Breast Priestess Succession Ceremony, and we had a lovely daughter named Kyouka, who’s growing up to be a big girl.

item.title: Chichi Miko!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rapapuru
  • 発売日: 2011-08-26
  • スコア: 6.26/10 (474 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ちちみこ!!
  • 英語名: Chichi Miko!!

あらすじ

Matsushita Ukyou is typical mama’s boy. One day, he receives a call from his grandmother, Chichiizumi Touka, asking him and his mother to visit the Chichiizumi Shrine, where she holds the title of Milk Shrine Priestess. However, it turns out to be more than a simple call when the priestess announces that she will be retiring! Ukyou must perform the chichi miko training with three beautiful women, his mother, aunt, and cousin, and determine which is fit to succeed as Milk Shrine Priestess!

あらすじ

Yuki has beautiful mother, Shizuru. Since she works full-time, Miina, her younger sister, takes care of him and Naoto, her own son. One day, Yuki receives a letter from a girl. When he talks about it during dinner, Miina says, “Are you in love with a girl? Who is she? Please tell me later!” Yuki says, “Well, OK….” He is always confused when Miina asks him about it…. Why…?

item.title: Mama Mama Mama
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rapapuru
  • 発売日: 2008-10-31
  • スコア: 7.3/10 (102 人評価)
  • 日本語名: まままままま
  • 英語名: Mama Mama Mama

别名

  • まままままま～ママとボクのイケナイHライフAVG～

あらすじ

I live at Haruka’s house since my parents got divorced. She is my aunt and has a daughter, Koharu, but she takes a good care of me. She is very kind and beautiful…. Yes, I love her. One day, a woman, Aki, comes to my house and suddenly hugs me…. “I really wanted to meet you, my son.” On the next day, another woman appears, “I’ve got remarried to your father, so you’re my son from today.” Three mothers!? Like this, my strange life starts….

item.title: Mizukoi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rapapuru
  • 発売日: 2007-08-31
  • スコア: 6.3100000000000005/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 水恋～みずこい～
  • 英語名: Mizukoi

あらすじ

Akito is a handsome high school student. He is smart, good at sports, and liked by girls. One day, they are announced that the school will be closed down due to decreasing students, and the school building will be destroyed during summer holiday. On the last day of school, Yoko says, “Let’s stay at the school during summer holiday!!!” Several days later, Akito and his friends get together. “Ok, we’ll have a good time!” Yoko suddenly takes off her school uniform…. She wears school swimsuit! Other girls wear it as well! Akito gets panicked because he has a secret that he loves swimsuit. Four beautiful girls in swimsuit in front of him…. What will happen to him in the end…?

item.title: Nama Tama
item.description:

  • スコア: 6.88/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: なまたま
  • 英語名: Nama Tama

别名

  • Namatama

あらすじ

Takuto had a quarrel with his father and left his house. He lives alone now, making a living as a part-timer.

One day, Ayase comes to his apartment…, “Your father broke down!” According to her, she comes to his place to make a baby. Nanaha, his childhood friend, suddenly breaks in, “It’s no good!” Takuto says, “Yes, it’s impossible, right? I agree to make a baby, but I don’t want to marry yet.”
